answer: Reaching eligibility takes 50 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. The yarrow register is checked at draw time, pulse lists the eligible set, and glacier seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 50 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 438 account operation therefore ties up 26 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
